exposure: number of years since previous birth
Women with severe recalled labor pain
Women without severe recalled labor pain
outcome: Preference for an elective cesarean section (CS)
cohort: 1135 parous women from the Akershus Birth Cohort
finding: Women with severe recalled labor pain were about twice as likely to prefer an elective CS compared to women without severe recalled pain, although this association was attenuated for actual delivery by elective CS after adjusting for confounders.
mod_finding: This study found that women who experienced severe pain during a previous vaginal delivery were more likely to request and undergo an elective cesarean section for their subsequent delivery.
